As we gear up for the usage-based billing meter launch next month, I want to walk through the current draft plan and get signoff from each of your areas. The draft right now proposes an immediate broad launch, two-decimal half-up rounding for billing calculations, 90 days of raw usage-event retention, and no mandatory invoice-preview review before we go live. Before I approve anything, I need to hear from billing engineering, finance operations, privacy, and customer support. So let's start with billing engineering -- are there any technical concerns or blockers with this plan?
